title: Annual plan paid after its service started
what_happened: A $190 annual plan started Oct 29, 2025; the payment cleared Nov 1. The books post deferred revenue when the charge settles, so it is not in the Oct month-end balance. The recon follows the same rule, so no break.

title: Voided invoice posted as revenue
what_happened: The Stripe sync posted invoice UBS-001340 when it was finalized; it was voided 9 days later with no successful charge.
prevention: Sync skips invoices that are void at posting time; daily clearing check.
correction_memo: Reverse revenue for voided invoice UBS-001340

title: Refund never reached the books
what_happened: Stripe refunded $49.00 to Winifred Castellanos; the sync dropped the refund event.
prevention: Alert on any Stripe refund with no matching booking within 1 day.

title: Annual-plan upgrade charge booked to revenue
what_happened: Ingrid Solberg's mid-term annual upgrade was mapped to Subscription Revenue instead of Deferred Revenue.
prevention: Map proration lines by billing interval, not by invoice type.
correction_memo: Reclassify Ingrid Solberg's annual upgrade to deferred

title: Payout deposit entered twice
what_happened: Payout po_QbvLDkPkTaC22Q0k8VisA75N was recorded as DEP00357, then entered again the next day as DEP00358.
prevention: Block deposits whose payout ID is already in the books.
